enableTunnelingCard.title: Enable Tunneling
enableTunnelingCard.description: Enable tunneling to route Roblox through the VPN

disconnectWhenRobloxIsClosed.description: Option to kill SwiftTunnel when roblox is closed

multipleAssetsThoughRelays.title: Route assets to multiple relays
multipleAssetsThoughRelays.description: This route assets to multiple relays, improving assets load speed. Might break authenthication, launch from web to avoid login.

enableRoutingCard.title: Enable Roblox Routing
enableRoutingCard.description: Route all Roblox API requests through the VPN. This can be used to evade blocked games in some countries.

enableCountryBanCard.title: 繞過國家封鎖
enableCountryBanCard.description: 將所有 Roblox 啟動流量透過中繼站傳輸並啟用 DPI 繞過。如果您所在國家封鎖了 Roblox，請使用此選項。這意味著啟用 Roblox 路由。

enablePartialCountryBanCard.title: Bypass Partial Ban
enablePartialCountryBanCard.description: Relays only Roblox control-plane traffic so blocked games appear and join. Gameplay UDP stays direct so you keep your real in-game ping. Use this if only specific games are blocked in your country (e.g. Vietnam).

activityWatcherCard.title: 活動監視器
activityWatcherCard.description: 監視您在 Roblox 上的活動。某些功能需要啟用此項。

serverNotifierCard.title: 伺服器位置通知程式
serverNotifierCard.description: Get notified when the client connects to a server.

processPriorityCard.title: Process Priority
processPriorityCard.description: EXTREMELY EXPERIMENTAL. Change roblox process priority. May boost performance.

optimizerCard.title: Enable optimizer
optimizerCard.description: Optimize Roblox by limiting resource its can use. Inprised by how 8damon/TASX-Roblox-Optimizer on github work. Anything nowdays are all rewrite in rust.
